# geo.new parity

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from scripts/docs/parity-data.mjs; edit that file, not this one. -->

An independent [geo.new](https://geo.new/) audit of https://geo.avarok.net/ (2026-11-19, rules `geo-new-rules-v23`)
found gaps GeoHarness's own audit scored as perfect (99.9). Every geo.new check is mapped here onto GeoHarness:
an existing check, a check added for it, the Lighthouse 100 gate, something GeoHarness generates by construction,
or the reason it is not scored. Evidence grades are those of [CITATIONS.md](../CITATIONS.md); everything below
grade A/B access and indexability evidence is advisory, so it lowers the score without blocking a deploy.

192 geo.new checks: added 12, mapped 43, generated 9, gate 56, not adopted 28, out of scope 44.

| geo.new | What it checks | Outcome | GeoHarness | Grade | Citations | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A02 | HTTP `Link` declarations | added | `signals.live_link_header` | A, A (spec) | `rfc-8288`, `llmstxt-spec`, `google-canonical-header` | Every page answers with `Link` to its twin and llms.txt, every twin with `Link: rel="canonical"`; the live audit checks sampled pages and twins. |
| CIT-02 | Sections an AI answer could quote | added | `extract.quotable_sections` | D | `geo-new` | Same rule (two or more 10–25-word sentences, or a list), scored as the share of sections that meet it. Grade D: advisory. |
| CORE-04 | Meta description length | added | `signals.description_length` | A, D | `google-snippet`, `geo-new` | Google sets no limit and truncates to the device width; 160 characters is a convention, so the check is advisory. |
| SCH-06, ENT-01 | Organization or Person entity node | added | `signals.entity_node` | A, B | `google-organization`, `ahrefs-schema-2026` | Generated JSON-LD is now an `@graph` with a top-level entity node (`<identity.url>#organization` or `#person`). |
| SCH-07, ENT-04 | sameAs on the entity node; profile links | added | `signals.entity_node` | A | `google-organization` | Half credit without `sameAs`. GeoHarness declares the profiles `identity.sameAs` lists and sets no minimum count (none is published). |
| SCH-10 | WebSite node on the homepage | added | `signals.website_node` | A, B | `google-site-names`, `ahrefs-schema-2026` | Generated on `/` only, as Google asks; other pages name the site inline in `isPartOf`. |
| ENT-05, EAT-09 | Contact point / contact details | added | `signals.contact`, `signals.trust_links` | A, D | `google-organization`, `geo-new` | JSON-LD `email` (new optional `identity.email`), or a `mailto:`, `tel:` or contact link. |
| EAT-08, EAT-10 | About page link; privacy policy and terms links | added | `signals.trust_links` | A, D | `google-helpful-content`, `geo-new` | About, contact and privacy links, a third of the credit each. Terms are not required: a free documentation site may have none. |
| ACC-03, ACC-04, ACC-05, A05, G02, G03, S02 | Search, AI search and user-agent crawl policy | mapped | `access.robots_bots`, `access.live_ai_agents` | A | `openai-bots`, `anthropic-bots`, `perplexity-bots`, `cf-bot-fight-mode` | Blocking: robots.txt must admit them, and the live check fetches `/` as each AI agent. |
| ACC-06, ACC-07 | Grounding and training crawler policy | generated | — | A (spec) | `cf-content-signals` | A policy choice written from `bots` and `contentSignal`; never scored (training opt-outs must not lower a score). |
| ACC-08, ACC-13, ACC-18, A01, A04, G01, S01 | robots.txt, Content-Signal, sitemap, public HTML | mapped | `delivery.live_files` | A (spec) | `cf-content-signals`, `llmstxt-spec` | Blocking live check of HTML pages, robots.txt (with `Content-Signal`), llms.txt and sitemap.xml. |
| ACC-09 | Crawl-delay for search agents | not adopted | — | — | — | GeoHarness never writes `Crawl-delay`; a site rule that adds one is kept verbatim and not judged. |
| ACC-19 | URL listed in the sitemap | generated | — | — | — | sitemap.xml lists every indexable page by construction (a site that ships its own keeps it, with a warning). |
| ACC-20, A12 | llms.txt quality | mapped | `signals.llms_txt` | A (spec), B | `llmstxt-spec`, `ahrefs-llmstxt-2026` | Advisory: llms.txt is rarely fetched. |
| A03 | Markdown negotiation | mapped | `delivery.live_negotiation`, `delivery.twin` | A | `cf-markdown-for-agents`, `google-spam-policies` | Blocking, plus the twin/page equivalence check against cloaking. |
| CIT-01, G05, E10 | Scorable content / readable main content | mapped | `access.spa_shell` | C | `peec-how-deep-research-reads-2026` | Blocking: server-rendered text. |
| CIT-03 | Citation-ready block | mapped | `extract.quotable_sections` | D | `geo-new` | geo.new publishes no separate definition; the quotable-section rule covers it. |
| CIT-04 | Answer-first opening | mapped | `extract.front_loaded`, `extract.entity_early` | C | `peec-reading-budget-2026`, `indig-2026` | — |
| CIT-05, G06 | Question-form headings, content organization | mapped | `extract.question_headings` | B (preprint) | `what-gets-cited-2026` | — |
| CIT-07 | Tables or lists in the main content | mapped | `extract.tables_kept`, `extract.quotable_sections` | A | `htmlrag-2025` | Tables must survive into the twin; lists count as quotable sections. |
| CIT-08 | Statistical density | not adopted | — | A | `aggarwal-2024`, `cseo-bench-2025` | Adding statistics helped only inside a fixed retrieved context (`aggarwal-2024`); rewrites mostly fail on benchmarks (`cseo-bench-2025`); no density threshold is published. |
| CIT-15, EAT-12, EAT-13 | Freshness, publication and modification dates | mapped | `extract.visible_date` | B (preprint) | `what-gets-cited-2026` | lastmod comes from git, never the build time; `dateModified` is in the generated JSON-LD. |
| CIT-12, CONT-05, E05, S07 | Landmarks, heading order, link names, main heading | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse accessibility 100 (landmark, heading-order and link-name audits). |
| CONT-08, LINK-04 | Link density | mapped | `extract.link_count` | C | `peec-reading-budget-2026` | — |
| E04, E06, LINK-08, CORE-06 | Navigation destinations, fragments, internal links, canonical target | mapped | `index.broken_links`, `index.canonical` | A | `google-ai-guide-2026` | Fragments are not resolved. |
| S04, S05, S06, E01 | Title, meta description, canonical | mapped | `index.title`, `index.description`, `index.canonical` | A | `google-ai-guide-2026` | Blocking; missing tags are injected. |
| S08, SCH-02, SCH-03, SCH-04, SCH-15 | Structured data present, valid, recognised, matching the title | mapped | `signals.json_ld` | B | `ahrefs-schema-2026` | Generated JSON-LD uses schema.org types and the page title; advisory (no AI-citation lift). |
| SCH-11 | BreadcrumbList on inner pages | not adopted | — | B | `ahrefs-schema-2026` | No measured AI-citation lift; the URL hierarchy is already in the RAG edges and the sitemap. |
| SCH-17 | FAQPage where FAQ content exists | not adopted | — | A | `google-faq-2023` | Google shows FAQ rich results only for government and health sites; inferring Q&A pairs from prose would be a rewrite. |
| SCH-05, SCH-08, SCH-14, SCH-18 | Required properties, Article author, deprecated types, Product markup | out of scope | — | — | — | Apply to content types GeoHarness does not generate (Article, Product); author markup is kept verbatim. |
| SOC-01, SOC-02, SOC-05, SOC-06, SOC-07 | Open Graph and Twitter tags | generated | — | — | — | Injected when missing (fill-only); not scored, no AI-citation evidence. |
| SOC-03 | Open Graph image | not adopted | — | — | — | An image is the site's own asset; GeoHarness does not invent one. |
| A11Y-01, A11Y-03, A11Y-04, A11Y-05, A11Y-06, A11Y-08, A11Y-09, S09, IMG-02, E02 | Accessibility, alt text, meta refresh | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse accessibility 100. |
| PERF-01, PERF-02, PERF-03, PERF-04, PERF-07, PERF-10, PERF-11, PERF-12, PERF-14, PERF-15, E07, IMG-04, IMG-05, IMG-06, IMG-07, IMG-10, E11, E12 | Performance, compression, images | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse performance 100, run on what production serves. |
| S10, S11, S12, SEC-02, SEC-03, SEC-09, SEC-10, SEC-11, SEC-12, LINK-06, MOB-02, MOB-03, HTML-01, HTML-02 | Viewport, language, HTTPS, security headers, mixed content, doctype, charset | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse best practices and SEO 100; security headers are the site's own `_headers`, kept verbatim. |
| S03, CORE-09, CORE-14, G04, E08, E09 | Indexing directives, canonical after rendering, snippet controls | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse SEO 100 (is-crawlable); noindex pages are left out of llms.txt and the sitemap. |
| E03, I18N-03, I18N-04, I18N-05 | hreflang | gate | — | A | `lighthouse-ci` | Lighthouse SEO hreflang audit; GeoHarness writes no hreflang. |
| CORE-02, CORE-11, CORE-13, CONT-07, HTML-03, HTML-05, HTML-06, HTML-08, IMG-09, IMG-11, IMG-14, LINK-05, LINK-09, LINK-10, RDR-02, RDR-03, URL-01, URL-03, URL-08, URL-10, URL-11, URL-12, URL-13 | Title and heading length, favicon, HTML hygiene, URL and redirect structure | not adopted | — | — | — | Site structure and markup the site owns; no evidence they move AI citations, and Lighthouse covers the parts with a measured user effect. |
| CONT-02, CONT-03, CIT-13, CIT-14, EAT-01, EAT-02, EAT-03, EAT-04, EAT-05, EAT-07, EAT-14, EAT-18, EAT-19 | Readability, keyword stuffing, attribution, specificity, experience, authorship, depth, address, disclosures | out of scope | — | A | `cseo-bench-2025` | Editorial judgement of the prose; GeoHarness never rewrites content (`cseo-bench-2025`) and has no published threshold to gate on. |
| EAT-16, ENT-03, ENT-06, ENT-07, ENT-08, VIS-01, VIS-02, VIS-05, VIS-06, VIS-07, VIS-08, VIS-14, VIS-15, VIS-16, VIS-17, VIS-18, VIS-19, VIS-20, VIS-21, VIS-22 | Reviews, Wikidata/Wikipedia, Moz Domain Authority, brand search, assistant answers | out of scope | — | — | — | Off-site reputation (search results, registries, third-party metrics or a model's answer): not a property of the build, not reproducible in a deploy gate. |
| ENT-02 | Entity name consistency | generated | — | — | — | `identity.name` is the one source for JSON-LD, `rel=me` and llms.txt. |
